retrievalProfile.description: A modernist layout featuring a high-contrast, cyan-tinted abstract musical instrument image framed by a wide white L-shaped margin containing clean sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into a large, high-contrast blue and black abstract image of a guitar on the left, and a clean white margin on the right and bottom containing structured sans-serif text in red and grey.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast cyan image against stark white negative space
Vertical list of names aligned to the right margin
Horizontal primary title spanning the bottom white bar
Color coordination between the red text and the warm undertones of the blue image
coreInvariants: The L-shaped white border framing the top-right and bottom of the image
High-contrast cyan and black color palette for the central graphic

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The abstract guitar image occupies the top-left quadrant, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, diagonal neck of the guitar provides a strong structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the high-contrast blue image, moves right to the list of names, and then down to the bold red artist name and title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the right and bottom creates a clean, modern frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blue image contrasts with the neutral white and grey text elements.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the body text
Extended width for the primary artist name
Thin, light weight for the secondary title text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between bold extended weights and light, tracked-out weights of similar sans-serif families.

preserve: Alignment to the right margin for the list

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and width of the primary artist name.
Matches the clean, thin aesthetic of the subtitle and list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, cyan-tinted abstract photograph of a guitar, focusing on the body and strings with deep black shadows. Place this image in the top-left of a square canvas, leaving a wide white margin on the right and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase sans-serif text. Place a list of names in grey on the right white margin, aligned right. Place the main artist name in bold red at the bottom left, and the title in light grey and red below it with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image high-contrast cyan and black?
Is there a clear L-shaped white border?
Is the typography strictly sans-serif and uppercase?
Is the primary name in red?

adjustableVariables: Tint color of the abstract image
Color of the primary display text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the blue image area.
Verify the red color is a muted, professional tone.
Check that the tracking in the subtitle is significantly wider than the primary name.
Confirm the image has a 'posterized' or high-contrast photographic quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Abstract high-contrast graphic + L-shaped white margin + structured sans-serif typography = Modernist Editorial Aesthetic
